| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | P Prepare (system level) |
| Phases | PH-MSA (primary), PH-TMRR |

| Writes facts | — |

| RACI | R: PER-PM, PER-ISSM · A: PER-PM · C: PER-ISSO, PER-SPONSOR · I: PER-CISO, PER-CIO |

Purpose: Register the system in the DoD Component registry for management, accountability and oversight, so the Component CIO and CISO can track its authorization status.

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: P-18 is the next action, and
   P-11 is done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/P.yaml`):
   - Authorization boundary determined (P-11).
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what P-18 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   P-18 feeds MS-A (Milestone A, milestone); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step P
   (Prepare) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: P-18`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-REG** (System registration): Record of the system's registration in the DoD Component registry, and of its ports, protocols and services in the DoD PPSM Registry.
     Read `templates/artifacts/ART-REG.md`, replace every `<<FILL: ...>>` placeholder, delete the template
     comment, and write `artifacts/ART-REG.md` with `produced_by_task: P-18` and
     `touched_by: [P-18]`.
     Write `artifacts/data/registration.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/registration.schema.json`, template `templates/data/registration.yaml`); summarize its records in the Markdown by ID instead of copying them.
   Why: `rmf status` counts P-18 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** P-18 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-18`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-PM (Program Manager / System Owner) | R, A | start here |
| PER-ISSM (Information System Security Manager) | R | start here |
| PER-ISSO (Information System Security Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-SPONSOR (Capability / Requirements Sponsor) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-18`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

## Inputs

- ART-BND (Authorization boundary, network architecture and data flows): `artifacts/ART-BND.md`, `artifacts/data/boundary.yaml`, `artifacts/data/nss-assessments.yaml`
- EXT-REGISTRY (Component system registry): the product directory, when the fork supplies it there;
  otherwise ask the responsible persona, and record an assumption for what nobody can
  answer.
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/ART-REG.md` | `artifact_id: ART-REG`, `produced_by_task: P-18`, `touched_by: [P-18]` | template `templates/artifacts/ART-REG.md` |
| `artifacts/data/registration.yaml` | — | schema `registration`, written whole |

## Facts

P-18 writes no facts.

## Done when

- The system is registered for purposes of management, accountability, coordination and oversight (DoDI 8510.01 Table 1 outcome).
- ART-REG records the registry entry for the system, in registration.yaml with ART-REG.
- An Enterprise system registers the ports, protocols and services of every boundary connection in the DoD PPSM Registry (registration.yaml ppsm, PPSM-001).
- registration.yaml lists every deployment site of reciprocity.yaml, an update after each received system accepted, and an exemption justification when reciprocity listing is deselected (RCP-008).
- `artifacts/ART-REG.md` lists P-18 in `touched_by` and has `produced_by_task: P-18`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-18`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-18` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task P-18`, naming what the outputs now hold.
- A fix that took more than one `rmf check` round gets a RETRY entry and a lesson
  (`_shared/journaling-and-lessons.md`).
